 Order

In this contempt petition, the petitioner / complainant has alleged that the directions issued in CCC.No.200043/2022 dated 04.11.2022 have been violated by respondents/accused and therefore,
sought to initiate the contempt proceedings against respondents/accused.

02. The complainant had approached this Court initially in W.P.No.203059/2019, which was disposed of on 21.09.2021, wherein she was directed to make representation to the KIADB for compensation / damages for the encroached portion of the land.

Further, directed that if such representation is submitted, the Board shall take a decision, within a period of 02 months from the date of receipt of representation and pass appropriate order, in accordance with law.
03. CCC.No.200043/2022 was filed by the complainant for not complying with the direction issued in the aforementioned writ petition.

While disposing of the NC: 2023:KHC-K:7479-DB said contempt petition, vide order dated 04.11.2022, it was observed by this Court that respondents have taken steps to acquire the land in question and directed that respondents shall ensure that the award is passed and the compensation is paid to the petitioner in accordance with law, as expeditiously as possible and at any rate within a period of 04 months.

04. It is submitted by the learned counsel for respondents No.2 to 4 that the award is passed on 23.08.2023 and the compensation is also paid as per the directions of this Court, in accordance with law.
The payment of compensation has been acknowledged by the petitioner and the same is not disputed by the learned counsel appearing for petitioner.

It is submitted that due to administrative reasons and unavoidable circumstances, the order could not be passed within the time limit,
however interest payable as on the date of payment of compensation has been calculated and paid.
In the light of the above, we are of the considered view that the contempt proceeding need not be proceeded with.
Accordingly, the contempt proceedings are dropped.

Sd/-
JUDGE Sd/-
